ClusterSet.description:
A set of clusters with cross-cluster statistics. `pairwise_cosine`
is the upper triangle without the diagonal, row-major: entry (i, j)
with i < j sits at `i * (n - 1) - i * (i - 1) // 2 + (j - i - 1)`.
